svg.text: 仅导出完整的留出或复核对照，排除训练记录。虚线表示相等；预测值是冻结代理模型的均值，不是不确定性上
model_scope: Mean-only interpolation inside declared bounds and actual training convex hull. No
uncertainty bands, live Aspen execution or physical validation.
system_boundary: Inherited HTL fixed-background accounting: feed, heater/reactor electricity,
fixed pump inventory, direct CO2/CH4 and wastewater; excludes separator heat duty and
cooling-service burdens; not a full-plant utility inventory
source_note: 配套 CSV 保留逐条来源和完整数值精度。缺失记录仍保留在原始文件中。本浏览器导出不独立认
